description: Sparse-input boundary on the diversion path: no address, no arrest date, no disposition, no arresting agency. Every unsupplied value must fall through to the renderer's own confirm-later token rather than being filled in.

eligibilityData.eligibilityBasisLabel: Expungement of a fulfilled diversion agreement based on a city ordinance violation under K.S.A. 12-4516(a)(2), three or more years having elapsed from the date the terms of the diversion agreement were fulfilled
